idea_name: Hidden risk-of-ruin fingerprints on closed-position books
mechanism: Score four mechanism screens on reconstructed positions: (1) post-loss volume escalation rate/streak (≥InpEscalationRatio), (2) same-symbol same-direction overlap plus monotonically worsening entries, (3) high win-rate / low payoff / large-loss-to-avg-win asymmetry, (4) classical Vince-style R=((1-A)/(1+A))^U; composite → A–F safety grade.
data_needed: Position-level CSV (open/close time, symbol, side, volume, prices, profit) from account or signal history
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo book EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY; any closed-position book; risk fraction e.g. 2% per trade
why_new_for_mis: Senses structural ruin mechanisms (martingale/grid/asymmetry) invisible to aggregate equity curves—complements MIS risk gating of copied or multi-EA books.

idea_name: Discrete-time competing-risks exit hazards with path covariates
mechanism: Expand each open trade into person-period rows; fit multinomial logit cause-specific hazards for TP vs SL with baseline [1, log t, t/Tmax] plus nine time-varying covariates; roll CIF forward and close early when E[hold]<E[close]−δ or (in profit) h_SL/h_TP>hazard ratio.
data_needed: M30 OHLC with ATR(14/50), EMA50, Parkinson20, Donchian range; virtual trades with 1×ATR SL / 2R TP / 96-bar time stop
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD M30; harvest 2023-01-01–2025-06-30; tester holdout 2024-07-01–2025-06-30
why_new_for_mis: Turns path-dependent survival into a bar-by-bar hold/close sensor that conditions on current MFE/MAE/vol state rather than a static barrier classifier.
quote: h j (t | x t ) = P( T = t, J = j | T ≥ t, x t )

idea_name: Sign-randomization permutation test for Sortino edge

quote: This article therefore implements the permutation test using sign-randomization: on each iteration, every trade's return is independently multiplied by a random +1 or -1.
